systems.name: 1.1 PS1‑Authentic Soft‑Renderer Finalisation
systems.notes: Complete the canvas2D entity rendering pipeline. Hide WebGL character meshes so only the soft‑renderer draws enemies and players. Wire ps1fx.js for 15‑bit colour quantisation, depth fog, and vertex snapping.
tasks: Remove WebGL entity meshes from scene (set visible=false or detach)
Ensure softrenderer.js calls quantize15 on every pixel
Apply depth fog via ps1fx.shade before final pixel write
Add vertex snapping (round projected screen coords) for PS1 jitter
Fix double‑draw: confirm only soft‑canvas shows entities

systems.name: 1.2 Texture Sampling in Soft‑Renderer
systems.notes: Integrate textureloader.js with softrenderer.js. Enemies and players should use procedural DataTextures for their surfaces instead of flat shading.
tasks: Pass UV attributes to softrenderer triangle projection
Implement perspective‑correct texture mapping in canvas2D
Use texturegen.js outputs for floor/wall/entity textures
Add texture atlas support for multiple materials

systems.name: 1.3 Frustum & Occlusion Culling
systems.notes: Reduce overdraw and improve performance by culling entities and triangles outside the camera frustum. Use AABB‑based tests.
tasks: Implement broad‑phase frustum cull for entity AABBs
Add near‑plane clip guard (skip tri if any vertex z <= 1)
Use Liang‑Barsky segment test for pillar occlusion (already in collision? reuse)

systems.name: 1.4 Lighting & Post‑Processing
systems.notes: Add per‑pixel dithering, scanlines, and a subtle CRT effect to enhance the retro aesthetic. Use existing luts.js and Bayer matrices.
tasks: Apply Bayer dither matrix across entire soft‑canvas (post‑process)
Colour banding reduction via dithering only (no true colour)
